about: The director comparison set (features/director-v5.clan): real requests from our own test projects (handyman, marky; 2026-10-09), each with the checks a good answer passes. must: every group needs one of its phrases in the prompt. forbid: none may appear (card text the words never asked for, a style the user moved away from). roles: the role each named ref must have. only_refs: the refs the job may send. budget: characters the director may add beyond the user's words.

cards.handyman_front: Full-body figure in dark lacquered Japanese samurai armour with a gold-crested helmet and face mask, standing front-on with feet together. Wears a short-sleeved royal-blue polo shirt with a small round white emblem on the chest. Carries a grey mop and bucket. Photoreal, plain light background.
cards.handyman_back: Armoured figure in black lacquered samurai-style armour and dark helmet with gold crescent horns, seen from behind, full length, on a cream background. Beige hakama with a red floral pattern; dark tabi-style footwear. Carries a mop over the shoulder.

cases.why: Runway has no angle control: the view must be said in words, without restating cards
Runway takes the first frame alone: the character is named in words, briefly

shot.action: Wide view of a busy family house, @handyman walks in carrying his toolbox, ready for a long day of odd jobs.
